_comment: Catalogue of 3D models for the good kid, m.A.A.d city tour. Each model is dropped into Assets/StreamingAssets/Models/<key>.glb. To use an existing/community model instead of generating, add "glb_url": "https://..." (a direct GLB download URL from meshy.ai/discover or your library) or "task_id": "<id>" to that entry and it will be downloaded instead of generated. Keys + target_size mirror Assets/GKMC/Scripts/Models/MeshyModels.cs.
